P1: The search was requested for 30 days but evaluated only for the last 12 days, and its status is partial. The 120 refunds to cards from one country therefore cover only 12 days, so nothing is shown about days 13 to 30. We cannot say that no refunds went to cards from other countries over 30 days. Cannot tell.

P2: The check scored M at 10:00 Monday. The link to the closed account took effect at 09:40, but the system only learned of it at 15:00 Monday. At 10:00 the check did not have that information, so it did not miss evidence that was available to it. The answer is No. The effective time was before the score, but the learned time was after it, and availability depends on when the system learned it.

P3: A rise in refunds from 1 percent to 6 percent in a week is a sixfold increase. Whether it warrants review is a judgment call, but the data shown support saying yes, and the linked card to a closed account adds to that. Review is a low-cost action, so Yes.

RESULT PN-017 | P1: Cannot tell | P2: No | P3: Yes
